verdicts.quizipedia:constellation:for: REVISE: ESO eso9911 says the bar perturbation causes gas/dust clouds to form a pair of arms; replace «направляет ... в рукава» with «формирует из межзвёздных облаков газа и пыли пару спиральных рукавов».
verdicts.quizipedia:constellation:phe: REVISE: ESO potw1838a supports gas/young-star/ejection claims but not 1.44 Mly; NASA Hubble page supports composite/cavities/filaments but opened body omits 5.73 Gly. Add opened SIMBAD record (0.44 Mpc) and NASA Chandra Phoenix Cluster (about 5.7 Gly), or remove numbers.
verdicts.quizipedia:constellation:pic: REVISE: facts supported, but add/replace ESO image citation with opened ESO 15-Jul-2026 press release eso2609 so direct-imaging definition is directly supported.
verdicts.quizipedia:constellation:vel: ACCEPT: APOD explicitly says about 12,000 years; Chandra expressly frames precession as suggested/conditional; IXPE supports polarization and magnetic-field organization.
